{{Quote|Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''blaster pistol''' was a small, hand-held [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

==Description==
[[File:RexHomeHero10312011.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex's]] favored weapon was a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]]]]
Blaster pistols had respectable firepower in an easily carried design.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Although a pistol would tend to have less firepower than its [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] or [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] cousins, they had enough power to kill a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and punch through body armor, though they did not have the energy to pierce the hull of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. There were thousands of different designs from hundreds of manufacturers, such as the popular [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Larger, more powerful varieties were known as [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]], while smaller precision pistols included [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]]s and [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blasters]]. Ownership and use was regulated in many systems, generally in the form of restrictions and regulations. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was one such example, as was the mining world of [[Peragus II]], where only lower strength mining lasers were allowed.

==History==
Pistols were common firearms of self-defense,<ref name="TRG1-" /> used as sidearms or backup weapons. From [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]] to [[Merchant/Legends|traders]],<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> blaster pistols could be seen just about everywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Blaster pistols were used extensively by a variety of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> as well as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used modified military versions,<ref name="TRG1-" /> while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] modified all of its blaster pistols to include a [[Safety/Legends|safety]].<ref name="newessential">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> A pistol may have been the one of the most common weapons, but was usually not the weapon of choice, mainly due to its short range and lack of power. However, some pistols, like the [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]], had incredible amounts of power and firing speed for a sidearm. Normally, a soldier's favorite place for his pistol was in its holster. But in emergency situations, it could mean the difference between life, death, or worse.
